name: Kuraishi Kanna
source:
An honor student at Kiraku High School. At home though, she's a willful daughter who is untidy, cheeky, and acts as she pleases.

Kanna lost her mother Haruna early, and thinking that it was her father's fault, she resents and extremely loathes him. She doesn't listen to him at all, and only talks to him when needed. 

"If only Mom was alive, I could have discussed something with her. It's your fault that she died, right?" is what she frequently says to condemn her father. 

Her father hinting about remarriage infuriated her further. 

At the same time, Kanna is desperately hiding an absurd trait of hers......

[Translated from [url=http://a1c.jp/~grandcru/product/jkomuchu/jkomuchu_chara01.html]Official Site[/url]]
